report_topic: Performance of DISCOMs pre and post Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana (UDAY)
observations_summary: The audit found that the Government of Madhya Pradesh took over only 48.70% of the targeted DISCOM debt. AT&C losses increased to 33.08% instead of reducing to 15%, and the ACS-ARR gap was not eliminated. Overall, the DISCOMs failed to achieve the financial and operational turnaround objectives of the UDAY scheme.
